subject: psychology

items.q: What does the behaviourist approach study?
items.correct: Observable behaviour and how it is learned.
items.why: Behaviourism focuses on learning (conditioning); the psychodynamic approach studies the unconscious.

items.q: Do all psychological approaches explain behaviour the same way?
items.correct: No — they differ (e.g. behaviourist, cognitive, biological, psychodynamic).
items.misconception: Yes, all approaches agree on causes.
items.why: Different approaches emphasise learning, thinking, biology or the unconscious.
